$comment: T-2.45: how sounds are placed in the world (ADR-017). `falloff` is a gain curve by distance in metres, linear between points and held past the last; null plays unplaced (the UI). A class's `priority` decides who keeps a voice when more than `voiceLimit` play at once: your own sounds get `ownBonus`, and every metre away costs `perMetre`. `occlusion` is what a box between the ear and the source does: a low-pass at `lowpassHz` and a cut of `gainDb`. Sound travels at `speedOfSound` m/s, so a distant blast is seen before it is heard.
